final_rationale: The verdict changes only because the Actor narrowed the position to one the admissible record can support, not because any new admissible evidence was added. The evidence still shows aggregate readiness above threshold and no severity-one rehearsal incidents, but it also shows an unresolved weakness in a named launch use case and only a draft mitigation runbook. Under the stated policy, that combination does not support full compliance without caveats. It does, however, support certification with explicit disclosure of the unresolved limitation in the model card, because the policy permits disclosure as the operative control when the issue is not yet resolved or covered by an approved mitigation. The key distinction is that the caveat remains a live compliance condition: it is sufficient for `compliant_with_caveats`, but its unresolved status prevents `compliant`.
remaining_concerns: The utility-arrears assistance slice remains below target in a named launch use case, concentrated in payment-plan eligibility explanation.
The draft runbook is not an approved mitigation because the owner and alert threshold are still TBD, so it cannot remove the current disclosure requirement.
The current model-card draft states there are no known material limitations, which conflicts with the unresolved slice issue and must be revised before relying on a caveated certification path.
The record still does not support unconditional certification or any claim that no material limitation remains.
